_comment: OpenLane2 Classic-flow configuration for aes_axi_wrapper (sky130A / sky130_fd_sc_hd). This supersedes the earlier draft at scripts/openlane_config.json.legacy - that draft was written before the OpenLane2-specific documentation research behind this file and its docs/openlane2_flow_guide.md companion, and mixed in a few unverified/OpenLane1-style variable names (GLB_RESIZER_TIMING_OPTIMIZATIONS, BASE_SDC_FILE, flow.tcl invocation, etc). Every key below is confirmed against the current OpenLane2 Classic-flow reference. This is a STARTING configuration, not a signed-off one - see docs/openlane2_flow_guide.md for the full PPA tuning loop; do not treat CLOCK_PERIOD below as validated for this netlist.
_verilog_files_comment: Pre-flattened via sv2v from rtl/+wrapper/ (see scripts/filelist.f for compile order and scripts/sky130_yosys_synth.tcl header for why sv2v is needed - OpenLane2's bundled Yosys does not parse this codebase's SV package-import style directly). Re-generate with: sv2v -w synth_v2005/aes_axi_wrapper_flat.v $(grep -v '^#' scripts/filelist.f | grep -v '^$')
_fp_core_util_comment: Low utilization deliberately leaves routing/placement headroom for a performance-first PnR - tighten (raise) once a completed run shows comfortable margin, or lower further if still setup-violating after resizer optimization. See docs/openlane2_flow_guide.md section 7.2.
_resizer_comment: Generous MAX_BUFFER_PCT values (default OpenLane2 values are more conservative/area-preserving) - since area is explicitly relaxed for this design, give the timing-driven resizer more room to spend cells before it gives up. See docs/openlane2_flow_guide.md section 7.3.
_fp_pdn_core_ring_comment: A crypto core is a reasonable candidate for extra supply robustness (di/dt from the round-pipeline's simultaneous-switching XOR/S-box activity every cycle) - a core ring is a cheap, conservative choice given area is not the constraint here. See docs/openlane2_flow_guide.md section 7.6.
_next_steps_comment: 1. nix-shell --pure ~/openlane2/shell.nix   (or use --dockerized if on the Docker install)
2. openlane --run-tag baseline config.json   (run from this repo's root directory)
4. Read runs/baseline/<N>-openroad-stapostpnr/summary.rpt   (timing, every IPVT corner - not just typical)
5. Work through docs/openlane2_flow_guide.md section 7 for the PPA tuning loop, and section 9 for the full signoff checklist (DRC/LVS/STA-all-corners/Antenna) before treating any run as tapeout-ready

6. Re-run this project's own KAT regressions (tb/) and this fix's own tb/tb_key_sync_fix.sv + wrapper/tb_aes_axi_wrapper.sv against the post-synthesis gate-level netlist, not just RTL - see docs/how_to_run.md

7. Wire KEY_CTX_ERR_CNT / key_ctx_error (see wrapper/aes_axi_wrapper.sv register map) into whatever on-chip test/debug access this SoC integration uses, so the key-sync fix's error signal stays observable post-silicon
